narrative.title: Demo 1 · AI-generated school photo of a celebrity

items.text: “Website: direct media link”: This is very likely fake (AI-generated image) — 99% likely fake. (confidence: medium).
Hive's AI-image detector rates it 99% AI-generated — most likely made with stablediffusion.
Hive's deepfake check found no face swap (0%).
Second opinion — our local detectors agree: Uncertain (59% likely fake).
Not checked (tools unavailable — not a negative result): closed_watermarks, ufd_clip, api_sightengine, api_reality_defender.

top_gaps.question: Has the incident been reported?
top_gaps.why: Platform takedown and police action start only after a complaint; delays risk evidence loss and further spread.
top_gaps.next_evidence: Review and submit the prepared complaint (NCRP / platform).

top_gaps.question: Is “Website: direct media link” synthetic/manipulated? Current indicators: Moderate
top_gaps.why: Only 1 learned detector family ran; one detector alone cannot establish manipulation, and none can establish authenticity.
top_gaps.next_evidence: Run a second, independent detector family (install the local model, or a commercial API with your consent), and/or obtain an expert forensic examination.

top_gaps.question: Does the depicted person's authentic appearance/voice differ from the media?
top_gaps.why: Authentic reference photos/voice recordings of the depicted person allow face/voice comparison and expose inconsistencies (moles, teeth, accent).
top_gaps.next_evidence: Upload 3–5 authentic photos or voice notes of the depicted person, with consent, marked as reference material.
